tokens.font.body: -apple-system, system-ui, BlinkMacSystemFont, "segoe ui", Roboto, "helvetica neue", sans-serif

layer.css: [data-ryt="brand"] { color: var(--ryt-text); border-radius: 0px; font-family: var(--ryt-font-body); font-size: 40px; font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; text-decoration-style: solid; text-decoration-color: var(--ryt-text); text-decoration-thickness: auto; text-underline-offset: auto; transition: all }
